# Medecro

> Medecro is an AI-powered clinic management platform built exclusively for Indian doctors. It provides specialty-native EMR, OPD scheduling, AI diagnostics, automated patient communication, and medical billing tools across 12+ medical specialties.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://medecro.ai/): Overview of Medecro's AI clinical intelligence platform for Indian doctors
- [Clinic OS](https://medecro.ai/platform/clinic-os): 360° AI-powered clinic management — appointments, EMR, prescriptions, billing, and follow-ups in one platform
- [AI Communication](https://medecro.ai/platform/ai-communication): Automated patient outreach via WhatsApp, SMS, and email — appointment reminders, follow-ups, post-treatment care
- [AI X-Ray Analyser](https://medecro.ai/platform/ai-x-ray-analyser): AI dental X-ray analysis detecting 22+ conditions in under 30 seconds, built on the largest Indian dental dataset
- [Blog](https://medecro.ai/blog): Articles on AI healthcare, clinic management, DPDP Act compliance, and medical billing for Indian doctors

## About Medecro

Medecro is a clinical intelligence platform built for Indian healthcare workflows. It serves doctors across 12+ medical specialties:

Dental, General Practice, Cardiology, Dermatology, Orthopaedics, Gynaecology, Ophthalmology, Paediatrics, Psychiatry, ENT, Radiology, Pathology

**Key facts:**
- 2,000+ clinics live across 9 major Indian cities
- 90% faster AI diagnostics vs manual methods
- 92% improvement in patient appointment adherence
- AI billing has increased revenue for 500+ clinics by an average of 23%
- SNOMED CT-mapped clinical records
- DPDP Act 2023 compliant
- Supports Hindi and English clinical workflows

**Target users:** Indian doctors across all specialties who want to replace paper-based or generic EMR workflows with AI-native, specialty-specific clinical intelligence.
